description: This file defines the StreamHandler class for GuzzleHttp, implementing an HTTP handler that uses PHP's stream wrapper to send HTTP requests, handle responses, and manage stream decoding, timeouts, proxies, and error handling.

classes.name: StreamHandler
classes.description: A PHP stream-based HTTP handler for GuzzleHttp that manages sending requests, processing responses, decoding content, handling errors, and stream management.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request using PHP streams, handling delays, headers, and error conditions.

methods.name: invokeStats
methods.description: Invokes the on_stats callback with transfer statistics if provided.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Creates a PSR7 Response object from stream headers and content, handling decoding and headers.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a stream sink for response body based on options.

methods.name: checkDecode
methods.description: Decodes response content if content decoding is enabled, handling gzip and deflate encodings.

methods.name: drain
methods.description: Drains data from source stream into sink stream up to specified content length.

methods.name: createResource
methods.description: Creates a stream resource using a callback, with error handling.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream resource for the request, handling scheme, headers, SSL, proxy, and timeouts.

methods.name: resolveHost
methods.description: Resolves the host in the URI if forced IP resolution is specified.

methods.name: getDefaultContext
methods.description: Builds the default stream context for the request, including headers, method, SSL options, and body.

methods.name: add_proxy
methods.description: Adds proxy settings to options based on the provided proxy URL.

methods.name: parse_proxy
methods.description: Parses a proxy URL into a format suitable for PHP stream context.

methods.name: add_timeout
methods.description: Adds a timeout setting to options.

methods.name: add_crypto_method
methods.description: Adds SSL crypto method options.

methods.name: add_verify
methods.description: Configures SSL verification options.

methods.name: add_cert
methods.description: Adds SSL certificate options.

methods.name: add_progress
methods.description: Adds progress notification callback.

methods.name: add_debug
methods.description: Adds debug notification callback.

methods.name: addNotification
methods.description: Helper to add notification callbacks to parameters.

methods.name: callArray
methods.description: Combines multiple callables into one.
